theorems.name: Submission.dohr_vel_graph_area_formula
theorems.statement: ∀ n ℓ : ℕ, ∀ (D : Set (Rn n)) (u : Rn n → Rn ℓ), IsOpen D → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u D → ∀ A : Set (Rn n), MeasurableSet A → A ⊆ D → (μHE[n] : Measure (Amb n ℓ)) ((fun x => graphPoint x (u x)) '' A) = ∫⁻ x in A, ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (Matrix.det ((1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + Matrix.of fun a b : Fin n => inner ℝ (fderiv ℝ u x (EuclideanSpace.single a (1 : ℝ))) (fderiv ℝ u x (EuclideanSpace.single b (1 : ℝ))))))
